WorkspaceConfig.title: WorkspaceConfig
WorkspaceConfig.description: Singleton workspace configuration storing the primary Admin UID, business identity, global cost per GB in Toman, and Admin/Seller profit split percentage.

adminUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the primary workspace Admin.

adminEmail.description: Email address of the primary workspace Admin.

businessName.description: Display name of the VPN business workspace.

costPerGbToman.description: Infrastructure cost per 1 GB of VPN data in Toman.

adminProfitPercent.description: Admin share percentage of net profit (default 50, Seller share is 100 - adminProfitPercent).

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile and RBAC role assignment for Admin and Seller accounts.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

workspaceAdminUid.description: Denormalized UID of the workspace Admin for zero-lookup rule evaluation.

emailKey.description: Deterministic sanitized key derived from the lowercase email.

displayName.description: Display name of the Seller or Admin.

role.description: Role within the VPN bookkeeping workspace.

status.description: Approval state controlled by the Admin.

ApprovedEmail.title: ApprovedEmail
ApprovedEmail.description: Admin-managed roster of approved Seller Google email addresses.

email.description: Lowercase Google email address of the approved seller.

sellerName.description: Friendly display name assigned by the Admin.

workspaceAdminUid.description: UID of the Admin who approved the email.

status.description: Whether this email is currently authorized as a Seller.

SaleEntry.title: SaleEntry
SaleEntry.description: Individual customer VPN data purchase record in an active ledger.

ledgerOwnerUid.description: UID of the ledger owner (Seller UID or Admin UID for private Admin book).

workspaceAdminUid.description: Denormalized UID of the workspace Admin allowing Admin inspection without get() in list.

customerName.description: Name or handle of the customer purchasing VPN data.

dataGb.description: Total allocated volume of VPN data in Gigabytes (GB), including any New User bonus GB.

priceToman.description: Final sale price in Toman (after any manual override or discount).

originalPresetPriceToman.description: Original preset price in Toman before discount/override.

presetName.description: Label of the preset plan used, or Custom.

isPaid.description: True if the customer has paid; false if unpaid so far.

isNewUser.description: True if this customer is a new user receiving promotional bonus GB.

bonusGb.description: Extra promotional GB included in dataGb for a new user.

note.description: Optional note about the purchase or discount.

LedgerArchive.title: LedgerArchive
LedgerArchive.description: Snapshot of a ledger created when resetting the active sales cycle or sending current list to Admin.

ownerName.description: Display name of the ledger owner at archive time.

cycleTitle.description: Label for the archived billing cycle.

totalSalesToman.description: Sum of all sales in Toman in this archived cycle.

paidToman.description: Sum of paid sales in Toman.

unpaidToman.description: Sum of unpaid sales in Toman.

totalGb.description: Total gigabytes allocated in this cycle.

costPerGbToman.description: Infrastructure cost per GB in Toman at snapshot time.

adminProfitPercent.description: Admin profit split percentage at snapshot time.

entryCount.description: Number of customer purchase records archived.

items.description: Bounded list of customer purchase maps archived in this snapshot.

DataPreset.title: DataPreset
DataPreset.description: Quick-select VPN data volume (GB), New User bonus GB, and default Toman price package.

defaultPriceToman.description: Default price in Toman before any manual customer override.

newUserBonusGb.description: Extra promotional GB awarded to a new user purchasing this plan.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles and approval statuses for Admin and Sellers.

/ledgers/{ownerUid}/entries/{entryId}.description: Active VPN sale entries scoped to a Seller or the Admin private ledger.

/ledgers/{ownerUid}/archives/{archiveId}.description: Archived ledger snapshots created during ledger resets or sent to Admin.

/ledgers/{ownerUid}/presets/{presetId}.description: Custom quick-select GB, bonus GB, and Toman preset packages for a ledger.
